summary.en: JavaScript runtime and package manager. The official release ships bun-windows-aarch64.zip.
summary.zh-TW: JavaScript 執行環境與套件管理工具。官方釋出提供 bun-windows-aarch64.zip。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
